title: Men dadamning pulti edim
hero: Botir (1995-da 11 yosh: qirqma soch, ko'k sport kostyum; hozir 42: qisqa soch, kulrang sviter) + dadasi Erkin aka (45, mo'ylov, mayka va trenka, divanda) + opasi Maftuna (16, ikki o'rim soch, maktab formasi)
facts: Zenith 'Lazy Bones' (1950) — simli TV pulti (Wikipedia: Remote control)
Robert Adler, Zenith 'Space Command' (1956) — ultratovushli, tugma bosilganda 'chiq' etardi, 'clicker' laqabi (Wikipedia; Guinness)
caption:
1995-yil: uyda pult yo'q edi. Pult — men edim 📺😅

Siz ham uyingizning pulti bo'lganmisiz? 1, 2 yoki 3 👇

#99foiz #otmish #nostalgiya #90lar #televizor #ozbekcha #uzbekistan #reels

scenes.speaker: jahongir
scenes.tts: [shouting] Botir! Bolam, ikkinchi kanalga o'tkazib yubor-chi! Futbol boshlanyapti!
scenes.text: Botir! Bolam, ikkinchi kanalga o'tkazib yubor-chi! Futbol boshlanyapti!
scenes.frames: 1995, Uzbek living room, dad on sofa shouting, 11yo boy jumps up from carpet; close-up of dad's face; boy running to old TV

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [chuckles] To'qson beshinchi yil. Uyda pult yo'q edi. Aniqrog'i, pult bor edi. Uning ismi Botir edi.
scenes.text: To'qson beshinchi yil. Uyda pult yo'q edi. Aniqrog'i, pult bor edi. Uning ismi Botir edi.
scenes.frames: boy standing next to big CRT TV like a soldier; close-up of boy's finger on chunky channel knob; dad pointing lazily

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [playful] Pultning vazifalari: kanalni almashtirish, ovozni balandlatish, antennani ushlab turish va dadasi uxlab qolsa, televizorni o'chirish.
scenes.text: Pultning vazifalari: kanalni almashtirish, ovozni balandlatish, antennani ushlab turish va dadasi uxlab qolsa, televizorni o'chirish.
scenes.frames: boy turning volume knob; dad asleep snoring on sofa with TV glow; boy tiptoeing to switch off TV

scenes.speaker: jahongir
scenes.tts: [annoyed] Endi antennani ushlab tur! Yo'q, chaproqqa... Ha, ha, o'sha yerda tur! Qimirlama!
scenes.text: Endi antennani ushlab tur! Yo'q, chaproqqa... Ha, ha, o'sha yerda tur! Qimirlama!
scenes.frames: boy holding rabbit-ear antenna up high in odd pose; TV screen full of static snow; dad leaning forward

scenes.speaker: dilnoza
scenes.tts: [laughs] Dadajon, Botir ikki soatdan beri antenna ushlab turibdi-ku! Qo'li uxlab qoldi!
scenes.text: Dadajon, Botir ikki soatdan beri antenna ushlab turibdi-ku! Qo'li uxlab qoldi!
scenes.frames: teen sister Maftuna laughing in doorway; boy frozen with numb arm, sweat drop; clock on wall

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [curious] Vaholanki, dunyodagi birinchi pultlardan biri ming to'qqiz yuz elliginchi yilda chiqqan. Zenith kompaniyasining «Lazy Bones» pulti — tarjimasi «Dangasa suyaklar». U televizorga sim bilan ulangan edi.
scenes.text: Vaholanki, dunyodagi birinchi pultlardan biri ming to'qqiz yuz elliginchi yilda chiqqan. Zenith kompaniyasining «Lazy Bones» pulti — tarjimasi «Dangasa suyaklar». U televizorga sim bilan ulangan edi.
scenes.frames: 1950s American living room, man in armchair holding a wired remote with long cable to wooden TV; close-up of cable tangled around feet

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [excited] Olti yildan keyin muhandis Robert Adler simsiz pult yasadi. U ultratovush bilan ishlardi va tugma bosilganda «chiq» etib ovoz chiqarardi. Shuning uchun uni «klikker» deb atashgan.
scenes.text: Olti yildan keyin muhandis Robert Adler simsiz pult yasadi. U ultratovush bilan ishlardi va tugma bosilganda «chiq» etib ovoz chiqarardi. Shuning uchun uni «klikker» deb atashgan.
scenes.frames: 1950s engineer workshop with early wireless remote prototype; close-up of finger pressing big button with sound waves; housewife amazed, TV changing channel

scenes.speaker: jahongir
scenes.tts: [laughs] Bizning ham klikkerimiz bor edi! «Botir!» desam — chiq etib o'rnidan turardi!
scenes.text: Bizning ham klikkerimiz bor edi! «Botir!» desam — chiq etib o'rnidan turardi!
scenes.frames: dad laughing on sofa snapping fingers; boy springing up like a spring from the carpet

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [warmly] Yillar o'tdi. Botir katta bo'ldi. Endi uning ham o'g'li bor.
scenes.text: Yillar o'tdi. Botir katta bo'ldi. Endi uning ham o'g'li bor.
scenes.frames: time transition: same living room modernized, flat TV; adult Botir (42) on sofa, his 10yo son with a smartphone

scenes.speaker: sardor
scenes.tts: [sighs] O'g'lim, kanalni almashtir desam, «Dada, ovozli yordamchiga ayting» deydi. Men esa butun bolaligimni antenna ushlab o'tkazganman!
scenes.text: O'g'lim, kanalni almashtir desam, «Dada, ovozli yordamchiga ayting» deydi. Men esa butun bolaligimni antenna ushlab o'tkazganman!
scenes.frames: adult Botir talking to smart speaker awkwardly; son laughing; Botir holding an old antenna nostalgically

scenes.speaker: bekzod
scenes.tts: [excited] Siz ham uyingizning pulti bo'lganmisiz? Bir — ha, men edim. Ikki — opam edi. Uch — bizda haqiqiy pult bor edi. Izohda yozing!
scenes.text: Siz ham uyingizning pulti bo'lganmisiz? Bir — ha, men edim. Ikki — opam edi. Uch — bizda haqiqiy pult bor edi. Izohda yozing!
scenes.frames: old rabbit-ear antenna and chunky knob TV on a shelf, warm light; final
